name: London Eye
description: The London Eye Ferris Wheel, also called the Millennium Wheel, is located on the Thames River and was built by the United Kingdom to celebrate the advent of the year 2000. The Ferris wheel is 135 meters high and was once the tallest in the world. Sitting on it, you can overlook the whole of London. It is one of the landmarks of London and the most popular tourist attraction in London. At night, the Ferris wheel will transform into a huge bright halo, like a bright eye in the night sky, which greatly adds to the dreamy temperament of the Thames River and brings new vitality to ancient London.
